lines.text: In 1995, a man named McArthur Wheeler robbed two banks in broad daylight
In fact, he smiled straight into the security cameras.
See, McArthur knew that lemon juice can be used as invisible ink.
So he figured, if lemon juice makes ink invisible,
rubbing it all over his face would make HIM invisible to cameras.
He even tested it with a Polaroid camera first.
He snapped a photo, but accidentally aimed at the ceiling,
saw nothing on the film, and said: It works!
An hour later, police arrested him at his house.
He was genuinely shocked, crying out: But I wore the juice!
This true story inspired scientists to discover the Dunning-Kruger effect:
the less you know, the more confident you are.
